prompt: Complete a static paint method that fills an area with a horizontal GradientPaint and then switches the paint back to a solid colour for a footer strip.
explanation: GradientPaint is a Paint, not a Color, so it is installed with setPaint rather than setColor and then every fill uses it until you replace it. The two anchor points decide the direction: (0,0) to (width,0) gives a purely horizontal ramp, so a pixel's colour depends on its x coordinate alone. Setting a plain Color back on the Graphics2D replaces the gradient, which is why the footer strip comes out solid red.
hints: GradientPaint(x1, y1, color1, x2, y2, color2) -- put both anchors on the same y so the ramp is horizontal.
Use setPaint for the gradient; setColor would only take a Color.
The footer must be drawn after the gradient fill, and you must set a solid paint first or it will be part of the gradient.
